decisions_made: Loop Engineering is the framing: build, measure, repair the self-improvement loop
A learning system must distill what SHOULD have happened, not record what DID (else it reinforces its first mistakes) -- the core L2 principle
Effect size tracks genuinely hidden structure, not task size; quirks matching model training priors produce no effect (a null result is not proof the loop fails)
Memory mirrored into repo .harness/memory/ is a snapshot, not a live sync; source of truth stays ~/.claude
